# idle-blocker

The `agents` idle blocker: conversations `starting` / `working`
(`isAgentBusy`) in THIS backend's database — on main, every conversation the
app launched. A conversation a worktree backend launched lives in that fork
and is not seen; its builds and tests still are (the `ops` blocker), and so is
the duress it causes. A Claude Code session started outside the app is not
seen either.

## Plugin reference

- Description: Idle blocker `agents`: any conversation starting or working (isAgentBusy) keeps the host busy; every conversation.statusChanged that crosses that line asks the idle signal to re-evaluate.
- Server:
  - Contributes:
    - `host.idle-blocker` "agents"
    - `trigger` "conversations.idle-blocker.notify"
  - Uses:
    - `database.db`
    - `infra/events.Trigger`
    - `infra/host/idle.IdleBlocker`
    - `infra/host/idle.requestIdleEvaluation`
    - `infra/jobs.defineJob`
    - `tasks/tasks-core._conversations`
    - `tasks/tasks-core.conversationStatusChanged`
  - Register: `defineJob('conversations.idle-blocker.notify')`
